question: Which Anuttara Vāgvādinī yoginī is invoked through the transmitted syllables aiṃblūṃraṃstrīṃ?
premises: The formula contains the transmitted syllables aiṃblūṃraṃstrīṃ.
The colophon names Anuttara Vāgvādinī Yoginī.
It is designated as a root mantra.
inference: This transmitted formula is the root mantra of Anuttara Vāgvādinī Yoginī.
plain_english: “Aiṃblūṃraṃstrīṃ” — thus is the root mantra of Anuttara Vāgvādinī Yoginī.
